title: Aww (Crowd)
blurb: A studio audience melting in unison, which is a strange thing to have on tap. The crowd aww is the laugh track's soft-hearted sibling, built for the exact moment a sitcom child says something unexpectedly sweet, and it carries every ounce of that manufactured warmth with it. Play it over puppies, over babies, over grown men being unexpectedly gentle. Or deploy it at something emphatically not cute, where most of the comedy actually lives. The audience has spoken. The audience finds it precious.
